questions.prompt: That plan indeed seemed useful, but it was dangerous.
questions.answer: Id cōnsilium quidem ūtile vidēbātur, sed perīculōsum erat.

questions.prompt: Not even by night did the guards abandon the walls.
questions.answer: Nē nocte quidem custōdēs mūrōs relīquērunt.

questions.prompt: The reward was not unwelcome to the weary rowers.
questions.answer: Praemium haud ingrātum erat rēmigibus fessīs.

questions.prompt: The general truly feared nothing, not even death itself.
questions.answer: Dux vērō nihil timēbat, nē mortem quidem ipsam.

questions.prompt: Some citizens applauded, but the majority remained silent.
questions.answer: Nōn nūllī cīvēs applausērunt, sed plērīque tacuērunt.

questions.prompt: Not even his closest friends approved of the plan.
questions.answer: Nē intimī quidem amīcī cōnsiliō assēnsī sunt.

questions.prompt: Not even by night did the watchful guards abandon the walls.
questions.answer: Nē nocte quidem vigilantēs custōdēs mūrōs relinquēbant.

questions.prompt: The fleeing enemy, once the town had been plundered, left nothing behind.
questions.answer: Hostis fugāx, oppidō dīreptō, nihil reliquit.

questions.prompt: That reward too, abundant and splendid, the victor deserved.
questions.answer: Illud quoque praemium, cōpiōsum et splendidum, victor meruit.

questions.prompt: The witness, however, dared to affirm nothing, not even the truth.
questions.answer: Testis vērō nihil, nē vērum quidem, testārī audēbat.
